description: Dead-man for the partial-loss test inside cam_motion.py. When it cannot run (partial_loss.py missing or raising) the script publishes partial_loss null and partial_detail.error, and binary_sensor.camera_motion_partial_loss goes unavailable - which camera_motion_monitor_down does not see (the staleness sensor itself stays healthy). The 60-min hold lives in binary_sensor.camera_motion_partial_loss_test_down (delay_on 60 min): a template binary restores its state across a restart and starts its delay from its first render, so a failure that already exists when this automation attaches (restart, reload, deploy order) still pages - a template trigger would stay disarmed. Also on if the attribute is missing altogether (json_attributes allowlist not updated). Pushes only on the binary's off->on edge (not from unavailable, which a template.reload produces); boot and the hourly :57 re-assert restore the card only, and inherit the 60-min hold through the binary.
